caption_L1: This bar graph is named Number of Russian tourist arrivals in Egypt from 2012 to October 2017 , by month (in1,000s). The x-axis shows Month along categorical scale from Apr to Sept while the y-axis measures 2014 with linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 400.
caption_L2L3: In 2014, the numbers of Russian tourists arrivals in Egypt went from a minimum of slightly less than 200000 to a maximum of ca. 350000. The largest number of arrivals was in October, followed by November and April. The smallest number of arrivals was in February.
